default_outage_scope: Missing price settings/service need not prevent deterministic default processing if persistent local identity checks succeed. A previously recorded history UUID disappearing/replacing intentionally stops the pass for reviewed recovery.

findings_addressed.finding: A later clock paired with an older complete snapshot could prematurely release protection.
findings_addressed.resolution: Python requires clock_slot == context_slot; Node uses snapshot slot and getBlockTime(snapshot slot).

findings_addressed.finding: Missing err field on a finalized status could be misclassified as failure and drop a publication barrier.
findings_addressed.resolution: Node requires an explicit valid err field, validates cached finality proof, and atomically writes status and finality evidence.

findings_addressed.finding: Replacing an operator or history database could reset publication barriers/budgets while reusing history.
findings_addressed.resolution: History immutable UUID/binding, operator UUID/program identity, persistent companion anchor and operator mirror reject changed pairings; a shared operator pairing is read and claimed inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE under the publisher OS lock.

findings_addressed.finding: Existing modeled history missing its UUID could silently acquire a new identity.
findings_addressed.resolution: Constructor rejects before schema DDL; no identity repair. A brand-new missing history before any UUID was recorded permits deterministic default-only handling while local operator/anchor identity remains stable.

findings_addressed.finding: Same-context reconciliation retry after an enqueue/observation mutation could bypass revision CAS.
findings_addressed.resolution: Cached exact fingerprint retry requires the current revision to equal cached post-apply revision; other retries fail without mutation.

independently_checked_properties: Exclusive SQLite publisher OS lock remains held across the full operator pass; no PID/TTL lock theft.
Cross-history concurrent pairing claims serialize in the operator store write transaction.
Persistent identity companion is separate from the held lock database and survives normal close.
Bound missing/replacement history fails closed; identity checks precede priced actions.
Unknown, confirmed-but-unfinalized and post-snapshot publications preserve queue identities; finalized success must appear in the complete snapshot.
Active loans and finite references remain protected; both timestamp and slot expiry must pass before reference protection ends.
Re-admission uses a new generation and cold history; old observations/acks are not reused.
Legacy synchronization only adds priority and cannot evict or demote.
review_conclusion: No additional issue found in the final reviewed scope after these fixes. No claim of exhaustive audit.
